In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] [[Thrawn's confederation|forces]] undertook a '''mission''' on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to recover the famous [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Moss painting/Legends|moss painting]] ''[[Killik Twilight]]''.<ref name="TG" />
